_help: Essays on the Essays page. Each essay is a Markdown file in essays/ (footnotes: put [^1] in the text and a line '[^1]: The note' at the end). Fields: id = the page address (#/essays/<id>); title; author; date = YYYY-MM-DD; summary = one or two sentences shown on cards; tags = spec tag ids from config/spec.json; file; questions (optional) = ids from config/questions.json to suggest, otherwise they're picked from the tags; art (optional) = which drawing to use (see assets/js/art.js); look (optional) = day, dusk or night. Newest first is not required: essays are sorted by date.

essays.title: What does the prisoner-voting saga reveal about Britain's commitment to human rights?
essays.author: Amin B.
essays.summary: The country that helped write the European Convention on Human Rights spent over a decade refusing to follow the court that enforces it.
